title: Harden snapshot and rerun error evidence
summary: Bounds snapshot refresh contention, returns safe last-known dashboard state when available, and records stable rerun/audit failure or recovery codes with plain-language operator messages.
reason: Home snapshot reads could remain blocked behind a long provider call, CSV rerun output failures did not distinguish missing, unmatched, or ambiguous results, and a legacy audit result shape could still abort a file-level audit update.
behavior_before: Snapshot reads waited unbounded on the shared build lock and surfaced generic 500 errors, rerun completion collapsed distinct output-evidence problems into a vague missing-output reason, and audit record mutation assumed every result carried the TX3G invalid-count field.
behavior_after: Snapshot reads wait only briefly, then use a recent last-known snapshot with a visible plain-language warning or return a retryable 503 code; rerun rows preserve stable failure_code and operator_message evidence; audit repairs a missing legacy TX3G field and continues with a named warning.
manual_validation: 47 targeted Python tests passed across snapshot, Local API, handler-policy, and rerun-result coverage.
Focused regression tests were red before implementation, then passed after the hardening changes.
No real media was processed; this change does not alter FFmpeg, source mutation, or publish behavior.
Rerun PlanOnly, nested-config, audit score-policy, contract-schema, parser, compileall, and Local API lifecycle smoke checks passed.
rollback_plan: Revert the Local API, rerun, audit, result-projection, inventory, test, and generated-summary paths in this packet. No media, manifests, runtime state, settings, source files, or final outputs were changed by this code update.
notes:
Adds retryable snapshot API codes: SNAPSHOT_BUSY, SNAPSHOT_READ_FAILED, and SNAPSHOT_INVALID_RESPONSE.
Adds visible last-known-status warning code SNAPSHOT_REFRESH_PENDING.
Adds stable rerun evidence codes including RERUN_OUTPUT_MISSING, RERUN_OUTPUT_EVIDENCE_MISSING, RERUN_OUTPUT_AMBIGUOUS, and RERUN_OUTPUT_EMPTY.
Adds audit recovery log code AUDIT_TX3G_RESULT_REPAIRED.
Refreshes generated summaries for all changed source and test paths.
